added_lines: AI infrastructure at scale took center stage at
From 1.6T Ethernet and scale-up interoperability to realistic AI workload emulation, our demonstrations and technical sessions explored how
teams can validate performance from connectivity to inference. Thank you to the customers, partners, and industry peers who joined us to exchange ideas and advance open, scalable AI infrastructure.
Take a look at highlights from the event, and explore the technologies behind the conversations:
co-organized a successful 6G Summit in Stockholm, bringing together leading researchers, industry experts, and regulators to explore the future of wireless communications.

Discussions covered key challenges and opportunities on the path to 6G, including spectrum strategy, advanced MIMO technologies, AI-driven networks, edge computing, integrated terrestrial and non-terrestrial networks, and sustainability.

A big thank you to all the speakers, participants, and our partners at KTH for the valuable insights, engaging discussions, and collaboration that made this event a success. Together, we're advancing research and innovation to help shape the next generation of wireless connectivity.
